text:
Situation: Quetiapine fumarate 100 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 45 tablets (5.7 days at 7.8 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 204 tablets (24.4 days at 8.4 tablets per day). All inventory is labeled by Aurobindo Pharma Limited (NDC 65862049101).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the registered plant for this NDC is Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004021229). The most recent inspection ended 2023-07-21 with a VAI classification. An earlier inspection ending 2010-09-24 received an OAI classification.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below two weeks. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer. No national shortage is declared. Alternative manufacturers are available but not required for immediate mitigation.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 65 tablets of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Monitor daily usage at both sites and reorder from current wholesaler — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing from NorthStar Rx LLC, ACI Healthcare USA Inc., Accord Healthcare Inc., or Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited at this time. No shortage listing exists to justify new vendor qualification or contract changes.
